protocol.controlRationale: PPO2 at frozen update 12 is the single shared focal control, played and counted once per deal/seat. Both fixed replicas are reported separately; original expert24 is opponent-only.
protocol.strongPanel: All nonfocal seats use the exact retained reference on Germany and frozen expert24 on the other three maps. Reference remains Germany-only, all phases. Expert24 is stronger available opposition, not independent algorithmic diversity.
protocol.mixedPanel: Nonfocal ordinal=(seat-focalSeat+players)%players-1; i=cellIndex+deal+ordinal. Even i routes expert24; odd i routes weakPool[floor(i/2)%len(weakPool)]. Weak pool is ppo0,ppo1,ppo2,teacherV2, plus reference at the end on Germany only. Full seat rotations and identical assignments across focal policies. This deliberately varies strong-seat occupancy; it is not uniform sampling of every possible population. Eight-deal extension: use actual deal 0..7, never deal modulo four. This is not the identical old four-deal lineup distribution.
protocol.seedRule: namespace[:smoke]:panel:cell:deal; independent roots between panels, identical within paired focal policies and seat rotations. No reuse of any historical training, diagnostic, confirmation or reserved-final roots.
protocol.routing: All expert-family policies expert24/replica1/replica2 use unchanged expertInputs, v2 priors and v2 fixed phases. PPO0/1/2 use unchanged v1 inputs/priors/fixed phases. Reference owns all its phases, Germany only. Replica models are never nonfocal. No labels, training, sampling or fitting.
protocol.primaryAnalysis: Four primary comparisons: each replica minus the shared PPO2, separately in each panel. Paired focal-seat differences -> all-seat deal means -> eight deals/cell -> equal 80-cell means. ddof=1; SE=sqrt(sum_c(var_c/8))/80. Exploratory normal 95% z=1.96 and four-comparison Bonferroni normal 98.75% z=2.4977054744123737. Conditional fixed-policy/schedule inference only. No partial-production inference; smoke descriptive only, no intervals.
protocol.secondaryAnalysis: Retain map, player-count, rule, map/count, full-cell and strong-opponent-occupancy subsets, reciprocal two-player outcomes and watchpoints. Germany analytical mean(1/n)=.29 is context, not played control or qualification. No non-Germany homogeneous-expert neutral assertion applies to these replica focals. Occupancy point estimates average selected-deal means equally within cells; variance uses all eight scheduled roots with fixed 8/K weights and zero analytic nonmembership contributions (not fabricated outcomes). Report selected-deal counts; sparse occupancy normal coverage can be especially poor.
protocol.precision: Eight deals per cell is a bounded diagnostic budget, not promised precision. Mixed lineups vary deterministically with deal; ddof=1 includes lineup mean variation and is conservative in expectation. Normal coverage approximate. No population-pooling or training-variance inference.
protocol.nextDecision: Report both replicas and both panels without winner selection, automatic progression, qualification gate, retraining or deployment. Readiness and scientific results are separate.
protocol.storage: 640 atomic whole-three-arm all-seat deal batches/panel. 64 MiB output bound; save every completed batch, publish every 16. Never store models, states, actions, traces or labels. Interrupted partial batch discarded; identical canonical tasks may replay after lost ephemeral work, counted once. Resume only exact contiguous committed prefix and unchanged source/runtime/task identity.
protocol.execution: Six workers, one inference thread. Initial strong 6h, mixed 3h. Shared third recovery slot at most 3h only after BOTH initial jobs terminal; if both incomplete fixed strong priority. Recovery never creates new seeds or a missing panel, and no outcome-dependent extension is allowed; at most three jobs and twelve job-hours. FAILED/incomplete initial status remains honest. Recovery eligibility additionally requires actual inspected ERROR status with Job timeout evidence, not arbitrary failures; both initial terminal identities must be verified.

protocol.selection: Greedy four-training-map macro credit, earliest tie, zero-residual v2 teacher fallback eligible; Germany must not regress vs baseline and other maps may regress at most .05. Warmup then updates8/16/24/32 evaluated. Confirmation/whole-map transfer only after selection.
protocol.storage: RAM-only current trajectories, max100000 rows; initial/warmup/best/last transaction checkpoints, compact outcomes. Last embeds exact committed best bytes; bounded snapshots after stages/updates. No raw requests/action traces in artifacts.
